cr_data.provenance:
1926 until about early May 1967: The artist, Abiquiu, New Mexico 
Early May 1967 – 2018: Eugene (1899–1973) and Margaret (Milam) McDermott (1912-2018), Dallas, TX. [1] 
2018: By bequest to The Eugene and Margaret McDermott Art Fund, Inc., 2018. 
 
Note: 
[1] Painting Purchased as a pair from the artist in in early May 1967 in Abiquiu, New Mexico, with the assistance of Doris Bry (1920–2014), New York 
(Source: Dallas Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: 'Open Clam.'" Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: 'Open Clam Shell. 1926'" [neither inscription verified]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Open Clam Shell

description: A slightly open, white clamshell placed on its side spans the length of this narrow composition.
